issues.why: A full teaspoon of salt is added on top of salty canned cream of chicken soup, sharp cheddar and tater tots with no adjustment, so the dish will likely be over-salted.
issues.fix: Cut the kosher salt to ¼ teaspoon, or add it to taste after baking.

label: random
title: Charred Salsa Verde Carne Asada Tacos

issues.quote: until deeply charred and cooked to medium (135 °F internal)
issues.why: Whole-cut beef should reach 145°F with a rest per the safe minimum, and 135°F is below that.
issues.fix: Change the target to 145°F internal (then rest 5 minutes), adjusting the sear time as needed.

title: Texas-Style Beef Chili

issues.quote: 1 teaspoon smoked paprika
issues.why: Smoked paprika and cayenne are listed but no default-path step ever adds them.
issues.fix: Add them to step 6 with the cumin and oregano, or remove the ingredient lines.

issues.quote: pour in the chile purée (scratch path) or the remaining 2½ cups beef broth (bought path), then add the remaining 2 cups beef broth
issues.why: The list gives only 2½ cups of broth in total, but the bought path adds 2½ plus 2 cups, and the scratch path's 'remaining 2 cups' is also inconsistent.
issues.fix: List 4½ cups beef broth and word the step as ½ cup in the purée and 4 cups added to the pot.
